steps.name: Epilogue ~ A special visitor to the island

lines.text: (Hayden, who was standing still, quietly looks up at the sky as an unfamiliar energy comes over him.)

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: I've been on the island for a long time, but this is the first time I've felt like this. Marie, we have guests coming, so let’s get ready to say hello.
(Hayden strokes the head of the doll Marie in his arms. Then Marie nods and jumps to the floor.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Nice to meet you. It's Mir... . Ahhh, what is this?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: Pretty, right? This is my friend Marie.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Mir, please be quiet.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Hayden is still the same.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Hayden, everyone knows this, right? Greetings can only be received from Mir.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: … It's a face everyone knows.
(Mir checks the appearance of the spirits that arrived in front of Hayden.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: We can't not know. When you open your eyes, you will naturally know everything. Although there are times when it cannot be helped.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I apologize.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: How does it feel to have come this far, Narine?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: … I never imagined I'd end up on another continent, but I feel like I'm flying above the clouds.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: You already flew in.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hehe, that's right. It's all thanks to Iris and Harmonia. Because he allowed me to go to another continent and helped me practice flapping my wings.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: But that scroll… . It's been so long since I last saw you.
(Narin smiles broadly at Hayden and holds up a scroll.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: It's similar to Marie in Hayden. It's a shame that I can't say hello to you separately because it's a scroll.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: It's quite a gathering, do you have anything to eat?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I prepared food for Gerda just in case.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Great! Gerda's food never disappoints. Wow, sandwich!

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Come to think of it, Narin ate the food, right?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I don't know the depth of taste that people feel, but I often feel the pleasure of eating it.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: A spirit that enjoys the food of life... . It's not surprising because Mir is there, but you seem more familiar with humans than spirits... .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I don't know if I should be grateful to Echo for disappearing, but I'm fine with who I am now.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Wow, this is delicious! Gerda's food is truly the best!

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Other people don't enjoy food, so please eat to your heart's content.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Mir, I will make it for you later. I've done a lot of research so far.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I was wrong. I will eat in moderation. What do you do when you're born hungry? iced coffee… .

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: I feel sorry for Mir. Next time, prepare some fruit. and… .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Geass, I'll tell you about that. Are we all here now?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Anyone who hasn't arrived yet, no! There's a spirit that didn't come.
Aida, I'm here!
(No sooner has he finished speaking than the spirit everyone has been waiting for from inside Aie Island hurriedly appears.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Zoe, are you here?

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: What are they doing in there? A bird that looks like a dog? I was surprised to see the bird-like dog demons sleeping. Have you come all the way to Mandako? .

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: The kids in the demon world treat them like idiots, so you don’t have to worry about them.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Still not sure?

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: It's okay. Don't worry, I'm speaking to you as the spirit of the island.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Gramo said he understood.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I've been waiting for you, Zoe.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: There is also a child I am seeing for the first time. It gives Zoe. Since you speak like that, am I an old spirit?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I don't know how old it is, but this was the original way of speaking. Hehehe.
(As the spirits gather and say hello, Marie, who had been hovering around Hayden, walks out to the center.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Thanks, Hayden.

lines.speaker: 헤이든
lines.text: This is Marie.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Yes, Marie. Now that you've said hello, please listen to my story. I had something to tell you, so I asked to meet you here.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Harmonia, are you talking about the necklace you are holding?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: That's not it. It’s not like a new world of imagination has opened up.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Then… ?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I think he woke up.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I have a question to ask, who is he... .

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: It is a spirit of light that has waited for its owner for a long time and has not fallen asleep. Who left a voice for life in eastern Freios... .

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Where has Geumma been all this time?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: He continued to sleep in his original orcarium.

lines.speaker: 조에
lines.text: Orcarium? Don’t you pay attention there? What's the problem?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Someone forced him to sleep and then woke him up again. So, I would like to ask you a favor. This is also what Iris means.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: … Please find out where the black moon energy flows down from the crack to the earth and where it scatters.
